subject: Architect deep-dive: multi-region deployment sync
messages:
From: Lena Park <lena.park@acme.io>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: eng-archs@greengrid.com
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:14:00 +0100
Subject: Architect deep-dive: initial ask

Hi Mina,

Thanks for the quick demo last week. Our platform architects would like a deeper technical session focused on privatenetwork design, KV-cache behavior at high QPS, and rollback strategies across regions (US/EU/APAC).

Attendees: Lena Park (Lead Cloud Architect), Tom Sayers (Infrastructure), 3x engineers via eng-archs@greengrid.com.

Can we schedule a 60–75 minute deep-dive with one of your solutions engineers + a runtime engineer? Prefer next week but the team is split across London and Sydney, so we'll need a slot that doesn't force anyone to join at 2am local. Daylight saving is in effect here in the UK, so local offsets matter.

Some context: we run mixed-precision models and are evaluating Redwood Dedicated for predictable inference. We'll share a network diagram and a short runbook if helpful.

Thanks,
Lena
GreenGrid Systems

Attachment: network-diagram.pdf (stub)

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Lena Park <lena.park@acme.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 12:40:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Architect deep-dive: initial ask

Hi Lena —

Appreciate the context. We can do a technical deep-dive (SE + runtime) and will prepare a short runbook and a section on KV cache & rollback. To avoid midnight overlap, here are three candidate 75-minute windows (all listed in UTC plus local conversions):

Option A — 2026-12-07 08:30–09:45 UTC (London 08:30–09:45 GMT, New York 03:30–04:45 EST)
Option B — 2026-12-07 15:00–16:15 UTC (London 15:00–16:15 GMT, New York 10:00–11:15 EST, Sydney 02:00–03:15 AEDT)*
Option C — 2026-12-08 06:00–07:15 UTC (London 06:00–07:15 GMT, New York 01:00–02:15 EST, Sydney 17:00–18:15 AEDT)

Notes: Option B will be late for Sydney; Option C avoids a very late night for APAC. The DST point you called out matters if any of the parties are on US DST; December is standard time in the US, so offsets below are assuming EST/ GMT / AEDT.

I attached our draft demo runbook and the network diagram you mentioned. If you share a preferred slot we’ll lock a calendar invite and include a short agenda + breakout questions for the runtime engineer.

Thanks,
Mina
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-demo-runbook-v1.md (stub), network-diagram.pdf (refreshed)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Lena Park <lena.park@acme.io>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Architect deep-dive: initial ask

Quick note —

If the GreenGrid EU architects are on GMT (no DST in effect for them in December) and Sydney will be AEDT (+11), Option C on 12/08 gives the cleanest three-way overlap without pushing APAC into very late hours. For safety, we should also prepare a fallback 45-minute focused session for just EU + US and record the runtime portion for the APAC engineers.

I can join Option C and run the KV cache portion. Mina, happy to prepare a short config diff that shows quantization + cache tradeoffs for dedicated pools.

—Karthik
Senior Runtime Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Lena Park <lena.park@acme.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 14:10:00 +0900
Subject: Re: Architect deep-dive: initial ask

Thanks everyone —

Option C (2026-12-08 06:00–07:15 UTC) works for me. I'll act as the session host and keep an eye on attendee count + breakout for the rollout/rollback discussion.

Small ask for GreenGrid: could you attach the network-diagram PDF (if there are multiple versions) and call out any private peering or NAT/firewall rules we should be aware of ahead of time? That will help us prepare the section on TLS and port expectations.

Soojin
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

Hi all —

Quick heads up: a vendor audit pushed our London architects into a conflict on 2026-12-08 morning GMT. Apologies — would you be able to slide the session later that day to 2026-12-08 15:30–16:45 UTC? That time looks OK for London and New York, and for Sydney it would be 02:30–03:45 AEDT (still late but manageable for one senior engineer).

If that slot is not possible, our fall back is to split into two sessions: (1) deep runtime + KV cache for EU/US, (2) recorded runtime + live Q&A for APAC.
